shared_elements: head with facial features (in B) / head as knob (in A)
justification: Both surfaces depict anthropomorphic figures with limbs, and A includes stick-like figures with raised arms while B is a stacked composite of a head and torso with arms across the body — the only real correspondence is the generic human form. A is a multi-figure linear scene with long straight lines/poles crossing the field and several small schematic figures, while B is a single frontal head-and-body with modelled eyes, nose, mouth and incised netlike patterning, so the compositions, scale relations and rendering conventions are entirely different.
